label: Zyxel VMG3625-T20A dual-band AC1200 VDSL2 gateway
description: VDSL2 (profiles up to 30a, 100 Mbit/s) and ADSL2+ combo-WAN gateway with 802.11ac AC1200 dual-band Wi-Fi (300 Mbit/s on 2.4 GHz, 866 Mbit/s on 5 GHz), one RJ-11 DSL port, four gigabit LAN ports and a gigabit Ethernet WAN port for fibre migrations.
notes: Zyxel datasheet: WAN 'One RJ-11 interface for VDSL/ADSL2 (over POTS)' + 'One RJ-45 connector for Giga-Ethernet WAN port'; LAN '4 auto-sensing 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet LAN ports'; VDSL profiles '8a/b/c/d, 12a/b, 17a, 30a' (17a/30a cap the line at ~100 Mbit/s - no 35b); Wi-Fi 802.11n 2.4 GHz + 802.11ac 5 GHz up to 866 Mbps.
